growth_expectations.rationale: Activity declined in nine Districts; manufacturing declined most Districts.

inflation_concern.rationale: Prices increased modestly; cost pressures moderating, expected to stabilize.

labor_market.rationale: Employment flat to slightly up; hiring selective, turnover fallen.

credit_conditions.rationale: Loan demand flat; difficulty obtaining credit constrains development.

policy_uncertainty.rationale: Uncertain economic outlook; firms cautious, hiring on hold.
